sources.entry: Rocket - Makes typing emoji faster and easier using Slack-style shortcuts. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Rocket
summary.one_liner: Rocket is a Mac app that adds Slack-style colon shortcuts for quickly finding and inserting emoji.
use_cases: Typing emoji quickly in messages on a Mac
Finding emoji by name without using the built-in emoji keyboard
Sending gifs, images, and memes from a shortcut list
Adding custom emoji shortcuts and text snippets
Choosing a preferred emoji skin tone
summary.what_it_does: Rocket lets you type a colon, enter an emoji name, and press enter to insert it, mirroring Slack's emoji finder. A shortcut window gives access to every emoji, and users can pick a skin tone and use light or dark themes. The paid Pro upgrade adds a Search and Browse window, sending and storing gifs, images, and memes, custom emoji shortcuts, text expansion snippets, and emoji usage stats. The app lives in the Mac menu bar with a rocket icon.
notable: Slack-style colon emoji search that works in any Mac app
Pro upgrade adds gifs, memes, custom shortcuts and text expansion
Lives in the Mac menu bar
caveats: Many extra features (search and browse window, gifs, custom shortcuts, text expansion, stats) require the paid Pro upgrade at $10
Mac only; no other platforms are named on the page
